note: Layout inputs the Rosebud export does not carry, in plate px. A re-laid plate (any size) ships its own copy of this file; nothing in build_city.py assumes 5120x2880.
source: docs/pc-map-handoff 98d2cc5c crosshaven/build.py WALL (ref x5), plot table from the look-target README
plate_scale_note: World px per plate px: the whole plate (ground, layers, walkmask, heightmap, cell grid) is drawn this much bigger; characters keep their size. Least-squares over Mauro's item 8 ratios against Ironjaw (62.7 px tall, about 38 px wide): house 3x (median house 168 px), gate tower 4.5x (308 px), stall 1.75x (131 px), street 3.5 hero widths (68 px across). See CROSSHAVEN_CITY_BUILD.md.

ground_textures.scale_note: Coordinator review 1: cobble tile at 0.35x (a stone is a hero foot to shin across), grass at 0.7x; a second grass layer (rotated 90 deg, offset, 1.13x) blended by low-frequency noise breaks the clover repeat.
ground_textures.review3_note: Coordinator round 3: second grass layer at 0.6 contrast and 0.8 weight; very-low-frequency value/hue patches (+-6%); outside the walls 10% less saturation and 5% darker.

map_base_only.note: Mauro item 17: the map base first. These layers stay in layers.json with hidden=true and keep their walk footprints reserved; set map_base_only to {} to show them again.

thatch_swap.note: Mauro item 15: no thatched roofs in the city until Scenario Art repaints them.

plot_exclude.note: cathedral park inside the ring road (not residential)

ring_kit.note: Coordinator 17 Oct: wall kit v2 (docs/pc-map-handoff docs/pc/look_target/crosshaven_city/work/walls/kit2 + kit/tower). Ring on the 3 plate directions: N and S horizontal, four iso diagonals (slope +-0.5); E and W are corners. Modules are painted at hero = 156 px; all anchors in native module px. Pass --kit <dir with the module files>.

exit.note: the south road and the existing city_to_crossroads stub

exit.label: South-east road (placeholder: Southbridge road until the link is decided)

gatehouse_neg.note: kit3 diagonal gatehouse (docs/pc-map-handoff 8572a1e4). Base slope -0.433 like segment_short; art_slope is the parapet-matched slope: its parapet (-0.317) is sheared 0.07 more than segment_short's (-0.387) so the parapet lines meet; drop_px = curtain parapet 580 - 550 (about 5%). The near tower is on the left, so the right (far) half sorts behind a hero in the arch.

gatehouse_flat.note: kit3 horizontal gatehouse v5 (docs/pc-map-handoff 9e35405b, 1752x1041): flanking towers 433 px wide and 990 px tall, arch 284 px. For N and S, no shear; one piece sorted on the wall line. drop_px = curtain parapet 577 - 550 (+4.9%), the same mechanism as the diagonal, so it lines up with the wall walkway.

ring_kit.face_note: face_px (segments): front merlon top to foot, native px. Gatehouses with face_px and curtain_foot are fitted to the run's face; the kit3 gatehouses instead carry a parapet-matched art_slope and drop_px from the coordinator's metrics (gatehouse_v3_metrics.json).
ring_kit.exits_note: Coordinator review 7: every gate road runs on to the plate edge and ends in a gate stub to a region road (data). The city is outside the plane, so these are stubs, not seams; 'proposed' links follow the Crossroads road directions, 'placeholder' means undecided.

gate_road.note: Round 6: every gate road opens into a funnel on both sides of the arch: as wide as the arch and its towers at the gate (1.15 x the tower-centre span), easing (smoothstep) to the road width over about one gatehouse width, with an uneven, feathered edge.

ring_kit.corner_note: Round 5: every ring corner keeps its tower so the two runs never meet in a bare cut, unless a gatehouse span covers the corner itself (the W gate). The near-gate rule applies to mid-edge towers.

greenery.note: Approved map-base greenery (docs/pc-map-handoff 5edc29a3 docs/pc/look_target/crosshaven_city/work/green; pass --green <dir>). Painted at hero = 156 px, bottom-centre anchored.

outer_forest.note: Coordinator rounds 2-3: dense clumps of 5-15 trees with overlapping crowns outside the walls (about 140), hugging the wall foot and thickening into woods toward the plate edges; a soft dark multiply blob under the clumps; approved oak and cypress only; roads/river/gate approaches/bridges clear.

lights.note: Coordinator review 5: warm lamp light at dusk and night. Head points are fractions of the lamp art (x from the left, y from the top). Halo and ground pool reuse the world lamp glow art, additive. Performance mode keeps them still (no flicker). Outside Performance mode each lamp also carries a 2D point light that lifts the night tint around it.

gate_clear.note: Round 5: no tree or cypress in a clear plaza at every gate and water gate, inside or out: an iso ellipse 1.8 gatehouse widths across (rx = 0.9 x width, ry = rx/2); flowers and low bushes stay; benches, lamps and planters stay out too. The outer woods are placed around these plazas.
